detaileddescription.para: The BoundaryMesh class stores information about the boundary faces and their properties in an unstructured mesh. It provides access to various fields such as face cells, face centers, face normals, face areas normals, magnitudes of face areas normals, delta vectors, weights, delta coefficients, and offsets.
Boundary faces are organised such that regular boundaries are stored first, followed by the processor boundaries.
The class also provides getter methods to access the individual fields and their components.
